items.lede: Surprised by the hype around yet another documentary on Theranos fraudster Elizabeth Holmes? It has everything to do with this experimental comedian.
items.title: The New Fan’s Guide to the Unreal World of Nathan Fielder

items.lede: Nathan Fielder's documentary about disgraced Theranos CEO Elizabeth Holmes has created a constellation of colliding personas that interrogate the very nature of authenticity.
items.title: In ‘You Can See Everything,’ Elizabeth Holmes meets her equal in comedian Nathan Fielder
